aliases: Dao marks of the Heavenly Dao

summary.text: Heaven path dao marks are translucent white, thread-like traces of heaven path. Fang Yuan first recognizes them in Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer as all-inclusive dao marks that survive when other marks are destroyed.

claims.text: In the eighth layer of Crazed Demon Cave, after other dao marks are destroyed by the void, only a translucent white thread-like dao mark remains. From it Fang Yuan sees space path, senses time path, tastes wood path, and feels cloud path, then recognizes it as heaven path: dao marks of the Heavenly Dao. He has seen human path dao marks before, but this is the first time he sees heaven path dao marks.
Heaven path marks are one kind of dao mark; how marks accumulate and turn into attainment is on dao marks and attainment.

A void vortex can swallow a heaven path dao mark. After the mark collapses, the vortex is dyed in many colors, bursts, and leaves a newly created small world that expands from a tiny blue-white air bubble. Fang Yuan concludes that Crazed Demon Cave’s eighth layer is deriving heaven path dao marks, and that deriving worlds is only the superficial appearance.

After each round of a small world’s birth and destruction, that heaven path dao mark usually grows a bit. Sometimes a vortex absorbs three or four marks together and forms a larger world, yet after destruction only one or two marks remain, so total length can be lost. Fang Yuan concludes that heaven path dao marks can also be lost, or that the marks he sees still have not reached the standard Limitless Demon Venerable wants.

He tries many collection methods without success, and even has a premonition that Thieves Den would be unable to do anything to these marks against a rank nine formation built by Limitless Demon Venerable.

Feng Jin Huang tells Qin Juan and Sun Yao that Fang Yuan destroyed fate Gu and refined it into countless heaven path dao marks dispersed to the people in the world. The more heaven path dao marks one absorbs, the more beneficial it is for cultivation and for developing the immortal aperture, though lacking them is only a missed opportunity rather than a hard barrier.

Zhao Lian Yun watches Lian Yun blessed land change after absorbing heaven path dao marks: the ground cracks into trenches, torrential rain forms huge rivers and floods, then fertile mud and a dense river network remain. She concludes that with heaven path dao marks the immortal aperture transforms and becomes closer to a truly balanced environment, with temporary losses but much higher potential. She obtained only six and a half heaven path dao marks, all segmented, without a single complete mark.
